artworks.title: Burning House
artworks.description: The image displays dynamic, swirling lines and bold, angular shapes creating an abstract scene. The forms come together to depict a castle or fortress with flames and smoke billowing around it. A ladder is placed diagonally with a human figure climbing it with arms raised towards the sky. A horse-like figure is leaping amidst the swirling smoke, and a bird is soaring above the scene.

artworks.title: Elisha Watching Elijah Ascend in the Fiery Chariot
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chariot pulled by horses among clouds. The drawing is executed in a sketch-like manner with tonal variations primarily in brown ink. At the center of the drawing, there are brushstrokes depicting a chariot led by rearing horses. The scene is enclosed in an oval frame, giving it a theatrical presentation. Below the central scene, a figure is shown gesturing upward. The composition suggests a mythological or allegorical narrative, rendered with energetic lines and swirling compositions.

artworks.title: The Right Honorable Lady Elizabeth Butler, Countess of Chesterfield
artworks.artist: Alexander Browne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image is of a woman seated with her torso slightly turned to her left. She has delicate facial features, wavy hair falling past her shoulders, and is wearing a long dress with ruffled cuffs. She wears a string of pearls and holds a cluster of leaves in her right hand. The background includes a draped curtain and foliated branches.

artworks.title: The Right Honorable Lady Elizabeth Butler, Countess of Chesterfield
artworks.artist: Alexander Browne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman from the waist up. She is positioned slightly angled to her left with her right hand resting on her lap and her left hand holding some foliage. The woman has softly curling hair that falls past her shoulders, and her facial features are delicately rendered, with a composed expression. She is wearing an ornate dress with visible folds and texture, featuring puffed sleeves and a low neckline. Around her neck, she wears a strand of pearls. The background includes leafy branches and a large, seemingly carved architectural detail.

artworks.title: The Right Honorable Lady Elizabeth Butler, Countess of Chesterfield
artworks.artist: Alexander Browne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman sitting with her body turned slightly to her right while her head faces forward. She is depicted from the waist up. The woman has gentle facial features with a composed expression, and her hair is styled in loose curls that frame her face. She is wearing an elegant dress with ornate, voluminous sleeves, and a draped bodice, along with a pearl necklace. In her right hand, she holds a small sprig of leaves. The background is a textured interior setting with drapery and foliage.

artworks.title: The Lady Essex Finch
artworks.artist: Alexander Browne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with her body slightly turned to the left, gazing at the viewer. She has soft facial features, arched eyebrows, and a calm expression. Her hair is styled in loose curls framing her face and falling to her shoulders. She wears a sumptuous dress with voluminous sleeves and draped fabric. The dress has a sheen, detailed folds, and a rich texture. One hand rests on her lap, and the other grips the folds of her dress. The background features trees and a softly lit sky, hinting at dusk or dawn.

artworks.title: The Lady Essex Finch
artworks.artist: Alexander Browne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image displays a woman sitting with a slight leftward turn. She has curly, shoulder-length hair and a calm expression, wearing a gown with voluminous sleeves and a bow on one shoulder. She has one hand on her lap and the other slightly raised. In the background, there are trees and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Thomas Flatman
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, seated with his body turned slightly to one side. His facial features include a prominent nose and full lips, framed by long, wavy hair that falls past his shoulders. He is dressed in a dark, elegant garment with voluminous sleeves, and a large, light-colored cravat is tied neatly at his neck. The man is holding a document with a circular emblem or portrait and text. The background includes architectural elements like a column and a window on the right, showing a faint landscape with mountains and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Valentine Green
artworks.artist: Valentine Green after Lemuel Francis Abbott
artworks.description: The image depicts a man with a strong gaze, facial features including a high forehead, pronounced cheekbones, and a slightly pointed chin. He has light, curly, voluminous hair styled in a classic 18th-century manner. He is dressed in formal attire with a dark coat and ornate white cravat. The background shows a dark interior with a glimpse of an outdoor landscape on the left. The portrait is labeled "Valentine Green" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Clytie
artworks.description: The image shows a woman kneeling with her right arm resting on her head and her left hand on her knee. She has long, curly hair with a wreath of flowers and is wearing a draped garment that exposes her right shoulder. She is looking upwards with a serene expression. The background includes a dramatic sky with rays of light shining down and lush foliage at the bottom.

artworks.title: Mr. Foote in the Character of Major Sturgeon, in the Mayor of Garrat
artworks.artist: Johann Gottfried Haid after Johann Zoffany
artworks.description: The image shows two men standing in an interior room. The man on the left wears an elaborate historical costume with a long coat, knee breeches, and buckled shoes. He has curly hair and a smile. The man on the right wears a similar costume and a tricorn hat, holding a sword. The room is elaborately decorated with items like a map, framed objects, a fireplace with weapons, containers labeled "S.J.J.," and furniture including a large chair.

artworks.title: The Burgomaster
artworks.artist: Richard Houston after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man seen from the waist up. The man is seated, facing slightly to the right. He has a solemn expression, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard and mustache. His light hair reaches down to his shoulders. He wears a large, dark hat, a garment with buttons down the front, and a ruffled white collar. The man also wears a bracelet on his right wrist. The chair he sits in has decorative buttons and detailing on the upper part of the backrest. The background is plain.

artworks.title: William Pitt
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated in an armchair, looking to his right. He has distinct facial features, wavy hair styled back, and wears an intricately decorated coat with embroidery, a waistcoat, and a cravat. He holds a rolled document in his right hand and rests his left hand on a table with books. The background is a plain, tonal backdrop.

artworks.title: Richard Tattersall
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man known as Mr. Tattersall. He is standing, with one hand on a table and the other holding a wooden cane. His face is calm, with wavy hair under a wide-brimmed hat. He wears 18th-century attire and a book labeled "Stud Book" is on the table. The background includes architectural elements and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Nurse and Children in the Fields
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals outdoors. A woman is seated on a rock, surrounded by three children. Two children are standing beside her, and one is seated on the ground. The woman appears to be a nurse, wearing a white bonnet with ruffles, a dark shawl, and a white gown. The children are dressed in light-colored clothing, with various accessories like wide-brimmed hats and flowers. The background features a dense forest with trees and vegetation.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Elisha Kirkall, after Giulio Romano (formerly after Raphael)
artworks.medium: etching and mezzotint with woodcut printed in brown and ocher on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three adults and an infant seated and interacting with each other. The person on the left is a bald man leaning forward, holding a standing frame and looking at the infant. The person in the center is a woman holding the infant in her lap, guiding the child's attention towards the frame. Another woman on the right is observing the interaction. The infant has curly hair and is reaching towards the man. The background is plain with ornamental border designs.

artworks.title: The Full of the Honey-Moon
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman in an intimate setting. They are shown from head to toe. The man is seated in a curved-back chair, with his head resting against his shoulder. He has curly light-colored hair, closed eyes, prominent cheekbones, and a straight nose. The woman stands next to him, leaning over with one hand on a sword and the other on his chest. She has defined eyebrows, gently closed eyes, and full lips, with curly hair partially covered by a ruffled cap. She wears a dress with intricate patterns, reaching the floor. The man wears a formal suit with ornate details, including a coat, cravat, vest, breeches, stockings, and buckled shoes. Items on a nearby table include papers, an inkwell with quills, and a recently extinguished candle. The room features columns and classic decor, with a decorative vase in the background.

artworks.title: The Wane of the Honeymoon
artworks.description: The image shows a partial view of two people from the waist up in a close interaction. The woman is seated, her body slightly turned toward the man who is leaning in close. The woman has fair skin, delicate facial features, and an ornate hairstyle with plumes and a veil. She wears an elaborate gown. The man also has fair skin, styled hair, and wears a frilled collar and luxurious garment. He holds a mask in his hand. Both lack visible jewelry. The background includes architectural elements like columns, drapery, and an upholstered seat. A tricorn hat and a mask are near their feet.

artworks.title: Spring
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line. A windmill is visible on the right. The brushstrokes are expressive, capturing movement and texture in the clouds and land. The color palette is monochromatic, using black, white, and gray. Individuals and oxen are working the land in the foreground. The sky has billowing clouds, reflecting a sense of atmosphere and weather activity.

artworks.title: Stoke-by-Neyland
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. In the distance, there are trees and a church tower. The sky has expressive clouds with a swirling texture. The color palette includes shades of black, grey, and white. There is a pathway leading into the scene with two small figures walking on it. Large trees frame the sides of the landscape.

artworks.title: Stoke-by-Neyland
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a high vantage point. The horizon is low, with a row of trees. A church tower is off-center to the left. The church is surrounded by trees and buildings. A line of trees is on the right side. The sky has large, expressive clouds. A monochromatic palette of gray is used. A path winds through the scene, with two figures: one person working and another walking.

artworks.title: Noon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rolling hill in the foreground sloping downward. The horizon is high, providing a view over fields and sky. Sheep graze on the hill, tended by a person. A large, dark tree is on the right. Brushstrokes vary in the sky and land, with broad strokes for clouds and finer ones for grass and foliage. The color palette is mainly black, white, and shades of grey, highlighting light and shadow.

artworks.title: A Dell at Helmingham Park, Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a frontal view of a dense forest. A wooden bridge spans across a narrow ravine or creek. The painting features vigorous and textural brushstrokes with dark tones creating a shadowy effect. The color palette includes deep blacks, dark browns, and occasional highlights of light filtering through the canopy. In the distance, lighter areas suggest a path leading further into the woods, surrounded by trees and undergrowth.

artworks.title: River Stour, Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a river scene. In the foreground, there are boats moored along the riverbank, some with figures inside. The horizon is low in the picture, with trees and distant structures against a sky filled with clouds. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, creating movement and texture in the trees and water. The color palette is sepia-toned, with shades of brown and black. The scene balances natural elements with human presence suggested by the boats.
